βασίλειαν: βασίλεια — queen, princess; fem. acc. sg.
γλαφυρήν: γλαφυρός — hollow, smooth, polished; fem. acc. sg., of a lyre (φόρμιγγα)
γλυκερῆς: γλυκερός — sweet, pleasant; fem. gen. sg., epic -ῆς (= Attic γλυκερᾶς)
γνωσόμεθ: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; fut. 1 pl. mid. form, elided (γνωσόμεθα), reciprocal: ’we shall know each other’
δευήσεσθαι: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid., epic (cf. Attic δεήσεσθαι from δέομαι)
δύσμητερ: δυσμήτηρ (δυσ- ’ill’ + μήτηρ) — ill-mother, unnatural mother, one who does not act as a mother; voc. sg.
καλλιζώνων: καλλίζωνος — fair-girdled, beautifully belted; fem. gen. pl., of women (γυναικῶν)
κατακτείνας: κατακτείνω — kill, slay (poetic for Attic ἀποκτείνω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having killed’
κεκρυμμένα: κρύπτω — hide, conceal; perf. mid./pass. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’hidden’
λεῦσσε: λεύσσω — look, see, consider; pres. imper. 2 sg. (Attic ὁράω, βλέπω)
λούσασθε: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’wash yourselves’
μεγαλίζομαι: μεγαλίζομαι — exalt oneself, be haughty, give oneself airs; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep.
νοσφίζεαι: νοσφίζω — turn away, keep apart from (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you keep aloof’
παιζόντων: παίζω — play, sport, dance; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’of the men dancing’
πειρωμένη: πειράω, mid. πειράομαι — try, test, put to the proof (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (same form in Attic): ’testing’

πηούς: πηός — relative by marriage, kinsman; masc. acc. pl.
προσφάσθαι: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; pres. inf. mid. (προσ- + φάσθαι): ’to speak to’
σήμαθ: σῆμα — sign, token, mark; neut. nom. pl., elided and aspirated (σήματα → σήμαθ’ before rough breathing)
στείχων: στείχω — walk, go, march; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’walking’
στερεωτέρη: στερεός — firm, hard, solid; comparative fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic στερεωτέρα): ’harder’, + gen. of comparison
στόρεσον: στορέννυμι — spread out, make up (a bed); aor. imper. 2 sg. (Attic στρώννυμι, imper. στρῶσον)
σχετλίη: σχέτλιος — hard-hearted, obdurate, wretched; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α)
τέθηπεν: τέθηπα (perf. of obs. θήπω/ταφ-) — be astounded, stunned; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’is stunned’
φεύγει: φεύγω — flee, go into exile; pres. 3 sg.
φιλοπαίγμονος: φιλοπαίγμων — fond of play, sportive; masc. gen. sg., of ὀρχηθμοῖο ’dance’
φράσεται: φράζω — point out; mid. φράζομαι consider, perceive, devise; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will observe, perceive’
φρασσόμεθ: φράζομαι — consider, plan, devise; fut. 1 pl. mid., epic doubled σσ (= Attic φρασόμεθα), elided: ’we shall consider’
χρῖσεν: χρίω — anoint, rub with oil; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔχρισεν)
ἀμφιέσαντο: ἀμφιέννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἠμφιέσαντο): ’they put on’ (+ acc. of garment)
ἀμφιέσασθε: ἀμφιέννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’put on (clothes)’ (+ acc. of garment)
ἀνώγετε: ἀνώγω — bid, order; pres. imper. 2 pl. (the pres. beside perf. ἄνωγα; Attic κελεύω): ’bid’
ἀπέκταμεν: ἀποκτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 1 pl., epic strong aor. stem ἀπέκτα- (= Attic ἀπεκτείναμεν)
ἀρίστην: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, fem. acc. sg.
ἀτέραμνον: ἀτέραμνος — unsoftened, hard, unyielding; neut. acc. sg., of a heart (κῆρ)
ἀφεσταίη: ἀφίστημι — stand away from (+ gen.), hold aloof; strong aor. opt. 3 sg., intrans., potential with κε (Attic ἀποσταίη): ’would hold aloof’
ἄγαμαι: ἄγαμαι — admire, wonder at, think much of; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep.
ἐγγυαλίξῃ: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. with κε
ἐκθεῖσαι: ἐκτίθημι — set out, place outside; aor. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having set out’
ἐμβάλετ: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put on; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἐμβάλετε)
ἐμμεμαῶτες: ἐμμέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic -ῶτες (Attic -ότες): ’eager’
ἐρίσειε: ἐρίζω — vie with, contend; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would rival’
ἑψόμεθ: ἕπομαι — follow; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἑψόμεθα): ’we shall follow’
ἔασον: ἐάω — allow, let be; aor. imper. 2 sg. (+ acc. and inf.): ’allow’
ἕρμα: ἕρμα — prop, support, bulwark; neut. acc. sg.
ἡγείσθω: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, lead (+ dat. of those led, + gen. of what is led); pres. imper. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’let him lead’
ἰδυῖαν: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. sg., epic ἰδυῖα (= Attic εἰδυῖα): ’knowing’
ὅπλισθεν: ὁπλίζω — make ready, equip, array; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic -θεν (= Attic -θησαν): ’got themselves ready’

__broaden__.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … would’ (ὥς κέν τις φαίη ’so that anyone would say’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς) · also + subj. in an indirect clause after ὅττι: ’what … may’ (ὅττι κε κέρδος … ἐγγυαλίξῃ ’what gain … may grant’)
__broaden__.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object with a predicate adjective: ’heart’ (κῆρ ἀτέραμνον ἔθηκαν ’made the heart unyielding’)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’) · also negating a generic relative clause with the subj.: ᾧ μὴ πολλοὶ ἔωσιν ’who has not many’
__broaden__.πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with λέχος: ’solid’ (πυκινὸν λέχος ’the solid bed’)
__broaden__.σιδήρεον: σιδήρεος — of iron; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηροῦς), agreeing with οὐρανόν · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦτορ: ’iron’ (σιδήρεον … ἦτορ ’an iron heart’)
__broaden__.ἀπηνέα: ἀπηνής — unkind, harsh, unfeeling; neut. acc. pl., substantival, uncontracted (= Attic ἀπηνῆ): ’unkind things’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’unkind’ (ἀπηνέα θυμὸν ’an unkind heart’)
__broaden__.ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, more excellent; neut. nom. sg., comparative · also neut. acc. sg., as noun or adverb: ’something better, better’ (φράσεται καὶ ἄρειον ’will observe better’)
__broaden__.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with κάλλος: ’much’ (κάλλος πολύ ’much beauty’)
